title: LLM4Eval
desc: A workshop series and research programme on using large language models for evaluation in information retrieval — automated judgments, RAG pipeline evaluation, and the robustness of LLM-based assessment.

title: LLMJudge Challenge
desc: A challenge and benchmark asking participants to generate relevance labels with LLMs while maximising correlation with human judgments.

title: SynDL
desc: A large-scale synthetic test collection for passage retrieval, built on MS MARCO with LLM-generated queries and judgments.

title: TREC iKAT 2023
desc: Ranked 1st in TREC Interactive Knowledge Assistance Track with Retrieve-then-Generate and Generate-then-Retrieve models for conversational search.

title: IGLU Challenge
desc: Research prize at the NeurIPS IGLU competition, on deciding when a collaborative building agent should ask a clarification question and which one.

title: CPFair / PyCPFair
desc: A framework and re-ranking algorithm for joint consumer and producer fairness in recommender systems.
